sections.title: Section 1: Health Club Customer Research
sections.html:
occupation

(noun). nghề nghiệp

There are many occupations that you can choose.

accountant

(noun). kế toán

She wants to be an accountant after she leaves school.

membership

(noun). tư cách hội viên

In order to enter the club, you need to show your membership card.

recommend

(verb). gợi ý, đề xuất

I talked to my friends and they recommended me a few things that I should do.

word of mouth

(noun). lời truyền miệng

News can spread really quickly by word of mouth.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng, bị ảnh hưởng tiêu cực

She suffers from a lot of stress.

blood pressure

(noun). huyết áp

The doctor measured my blood pressure this morning.

facility

(noun). cơ sở vật chất

There's a new outdoor facility for fitness training.

reluctant

(adjective). do dự

My son is reluctant to eat fresh fruit.

privilege

(noun). đặc quyền

Rich people have a lot more privilege than poor people.

install

(verb). lắp đặt, cài đặt

I called a plumber to help me install the new washing machine.

swelter

(verb). đổ mồ hôi nhễ nhại, mệt vì nóng

He's sweltering in the summer heat.

air conditioning

(noun). điều hòa

It's hot today, so I need to turn on the air conditioning in my room.

condition

(noun). tình trạng bệnh lý

He has a skin condition, especially on his back.

(verb). đăng kí

If you are interested, then sign up now to join our club.

fitness

(noun). sức khỏe tốt

I've been going to the gym every day this week to improve my fitness and get into shape.

supportive

(adjective). hay giúp đỡ, khuyến khích

A good leader should be helpful and supportive.

sections.title: Section 2: Outdoor Survival Skills
sections.html:

(noun). hố

Let's move that tree into this pit.

shallow

(adjective). nông, cạn

The pool is shallow so you don't need to know how to swim.

stick

(noun). que củi, que gỗ

My dog loves to play with a stick.

remove

(verb). bỏ đi, bỏ ra chỗ khác

She removes her makeup before going to bed.

ash

(noun). tro

All that was left after the fire was ash.

cover

(verb). đậy lại, bao phủ

Many deserts are covered in sand.

layer

(noun). lớp

An onion has many layers.

wrap

(verb). cuốn lại, gói lại

Have you finished wrapping your present for his birthday?

earth

(noun). đất

The earth here is so dry that nothing can grow on it.

pour

(verb). đổ nước, rót nước

Let me pour you a cup of coffee first.

hollow

(adjective). rỗng

These metal tubes are short and hollow.

individual

(adjective). riêng biệt

Individual wellbeing is becoming more and more important in this era.

lean

(verb). dựa vào

He feels tired so he sits down and leans against the wall.

fungus >> fungi (plural)

(noun). nấm

Several types of fungus can be used in cooking.

edible

(adjective). ăn được

The food in the basket has gone bad, so it's not edible anymore.

poisonous

(adjective). có độc

Poisonous mushrooms are usually brighter and more colorful.

identify

(noun). xác minh, nhận diện

How can we identify the right person we are looking for?

mistake for

(verb). nhầm lẫn cái này với cái khác

People mistake me for my twin sister all the time.

nutritious

(adjective). nhiều chất dinh dưỡng

Fresh fruits and vegetables are highly nutritious.

moderately

(adverb). một cách trung bình

I like my food moderately spicy, but not too hot.

steam

(noun). hơi nước

The steam is coming out of the kettle, which means the water is now boiled.

ideal

(adjective). lý tưởng

The ideal world for me is one where we all live together in peace.

consist of

(verb). bao gồm

A pepperoni pizza consists of pepperoni, mushroom, tomato, cheese, olive, and tomato sauce.

survival

(noun). sự sinh tồn

Making a fire is one of the most basic skills needed for survival.

sections.title: Section 3: Research Project On Attitudes Towards Study
sections.html:
attitude

(noun). thái độ

It's important to keep a good attitude, even when in bad situations.

career

(noun). sự nghiệp

Throughout his career, he worked his way up from employee to senior manager of the company.

come across

(verb). vô tình kiếm thấy

I came across someone's wallet on the street today.

motivate

(verb). động viên

He's trying to motivate his friend.

discipline

(noun). kỷ luật

Joining the army trains young men to have a strong sense of discipline.

respond

(verb). phản ứng, phản hồi

She knows how to respond in an emergency.

strict

(adjective). nghiêm khắc, nghiêm ngặt

You shouldn't be too strict with your children, or they'll become afraid of you.

gender

(noun). giới tính

Do you know the gender of the baby yet?

summarize

(verb). tóm tắt

Summarizing a long paper is not an easy task.

striking

(adjective). nổi bật, đáng chú ý, đáng kinh ngạc

Despite being far away from each other, these two ancient temples have some striking similarities.

amaze

(verb). làm kinh ngạc, làm sửng sốt

They are amazed by what they're reading.

flexible

(adjective). linh hoạt

Having a flexible work schedule allows me to have more time for my study.

bright

(adjective). sáng dạ

My little brother is very bright and intelligent.

insight

(noun). sự hiểu biết, sự học hỏi

This book provides some useful and interesting insights.

collaborate

(verb). hợp tác

Everyone in the team needs to collaborate on this project.

minimize

(verb). hạn chế

You should do everything you can to minimize the risk to your business.

analyze

(verb). phân tích

After collecting the data, you need to analyze it.

derive from

(verb). suy ra từ, nhận được từ

As you can see, many current languages are derived from the old Indo-European language.

observe >> observation (n)

(verb). quan sát

They went on a trip to Africa to observe wild animals.

gruelling

(adjective). khó khăn, mệt mỏi

They have to go through gruelling training in the army.

recorder

(noun). máy ghi âm

Did you remember to bring your recorder for the interview?

concentrate

(verb). tập trung

You need to concentrate on your studies.

ethics

(noun). vấn đề đạo đức, đạo lý

Companies sometimes have to choose between ethics and profit.

relent

(verb). bớt nghiêm khắc, mãi mới chấp nhận

At first, he didn't want to sleep in the same bed with the baby, but in the end he finally relented.

questionnaire

(noun). trắc nghiệm, bản điều tra

A questionnaire shouldn't be too long, or else people won't want to complete it.

agenda

(noun). lịch trình, kế hoạch

There are five things to discuss in the agenda for today's meeting.

contribute

(noun). đóng góp cho

Everyone needs to contribute to the success of our business.

exhausting

(adjective). mệt mỏi

Working from home all day is exhausting.

briefly

(adverb). một cách ngắn gọn, nhanh chóng

First, let's briefly take attendance, and then we can begin.

valid

(adjective). hợp lý, chấp nhận được, chính đáng

Being sick is a valid reason for you to stay home.

regret

(verb). hối hận

He regrets the fact that he let her go.

sections.title: Section 4: Saving The Juniper Plant
sections.html:
colonize >> colony (n)

(verb). sống theo quần thể

Several types of plants soon started to colonize the area.

Ice Age

(noun). kỷ băng hà

The last Ice Age occurred millions of years ago.

virtually

(adverb). gần như

These apples are virtually the same.

invisible

(adjective). vô hình

Have you heard the story of the invisible man?

illicit

(adjective). phạm pháp

Police officers have jsut discovered a large amount of illicit goods.

extract

(verb). chiết ra, tách ra

They extract different types of oil from plants.

spray

(verb). xịt

You should spray some water on the window to make cleaning easier.

infection

(noun). nhiễm trùng

He has some kind of infection on his skin.

cuisine

(noun). phong cách ẩm thực

Phở is one of most popular dishes of Vietnamese cuisine.

ingredient

(noun). thành phần

Here you will find the most common ingredients used in Italian cooking.

flavor

(verb). ướp gia vị, làm tăng thêm mùi vị

This cup of tea is flavored with fresh berries and a little lemon juice.

wipe out

(verb). xóa sổ

The Australian fires wiped out a large area of forests that used to be home to many animals.

ratio

(noun). tỉ lệ

The ratio between the bananas and the apples is 3 to 2.

unbalanced

(adjective). không cân bằng

This scale is unbalanced, which means coins are heavier than paper money.

swift

(adjective). nhanh chóng

He's a really swift runner.

extinction

(noun). sự tuyệt chủng

The extinction of dinosaurs happened million of years ago.

halt

(verb). dừng lại, hoãn lại

We were ordered to halt by the policeman.

salvage

(verb). cứu trợ, cứu hộ

They are trying to salvage the people on the sinking boat.

lowland

(adjective). miền trũng, gần mực nước biển

We live in a lowland area, right next to the sea.

measure

(noun). biện pháp

Keeping social distance is one of the preventative measures against COVID.

seedling

(noun). chồi

After a few days, you should begin to see seedlings coming up from the soil.

shelter

(noun). mái che

There's a shelter on the camping site that you can use in case it starts to rain.

cutting

(noun). cành giâm

You can grow a new plant just from a cutting of another plant.

emphasize

(verb). nhấn mạnh

I highlighted the parts that the teacher emphasized in class.

detect

(verb). phát hiện

The hospital detected something wrong in his blood.

rapid

(adjective). nhanh chóng

There have been rapid developments in modern technology.

bush

(noun). bụi cây

We have some lovely bushes in our garden.

temperate

(adjective). ôn đới

The temperate climate results in some beautiful natural scenery.
